_about: Turok's policy for Amos's Turo business. Vehicles live in state/turo.json (added by Turok from Turo emails or by Amos). Edit anything here; Turok reads it every cycle.

links._note: Per-trip reservation links and per-car listing links are taken from Turo's emails when present.

pricing._month: January..December (Toronto seasonality: summer and December holidays peak)

lifecycle._policyNote: Claim windows mirror Turo host policy as Turok understands it; check Turo's current host policies and adjust here.

houseRules: No smoking or vaping in the car.
Pets only if agreed in advance in Turo messages.
Return with the same fuel / charge level as at pickup.
Tolls, tickets and speeding fines are the guest's responsibility and are billed through Turo.

templates.booked: Hi {guest}, thanks for booking the {vehicle}! You're all set for {start}. I'll send pickup details the day before. Any questions, just message me here. — {host}
templates.checkoutReminder: Hi {guest}, quick reminder your trip ends {end}. Please return the {vehicle} to {pickup} with the same fuel/charge level and take return photos in the Turo app. Thanks! — {host}
templates.thankYou: Thanks {guest}, it was a pleasure hosting you in the {vehicle}. Hope the trip was great. If you have a moment, a review on Turo helps a lot. You're welcome back anytime! — {host}
